text:
release_manager_lee: Hey team — scheduling the CinderPoint Dedicated rollout for 03/28 quiet window. Plan: staged traffic shift (3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%) with a 30m soak per stage. Pin runtime to `redwood-runtime@v2.3.1-quant` and model to `cinder-3b:2026-03-21`. Need ops/sre approval + QA signoff.

deploybot: deploy request queued: `/deploy cinderpoint-dedicated --model=cinder-3b:2026-03-21 --runtime=redwood-runtime@v2.3.1-quant --slice=primary --staged-traffic` ETA: 12:05 UTC.

kate_ops: Ack'd. I'm on-call for the window, will watch health and K/V cache priming.

kate_ops: Quick note — we'll pre-warm prefix cache for top 50 tenants 10m before shift.

amir_sre: Safety thresholds proposed: 95th latency > 450ms OR error-rate > 1.5% for any stage -> immediate rollback to `cinder-3b:2026-02-14`. Also circuit open if CPU on serving nodes > 82% for 5m.

ella_se: QA will run smoke prompts and eval set A at each stage. Expect 5–7 min for validation.

product_lead_juno: We need explicit rollback messaging for the customer — add short release notes and contact list. Link to notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/cinderpoint/2026-03-28 (draft)

sam_engineer: I pushed a small shim to handle a missing optional field in customer metadata — it's backward compatible but I want to keep it toggled off by default. I'll include a runtime flag `--enable-cust-meta-shim` that we won't enable during the first two stages.

release_manager_lee: Good. So plan: Stage 0 (prewarm, flag off), Stage 1 3% traffic (flag off), Stage 2 15% (flag off), Stage 3 50% (flag on), Stage 4 100% (flag on). If any alert fires, we cut to rollback and pin traffic back to previous model.

deploybot: Canary deploy started ✅. Logs: ```deploybot> starting canary: slice=primary version=cinder-3b:2026-03-21 runtime=redwood-runtime@v2.3.1-quant```

amir_sre: Monitoring dashboards linked: https://grafana.redwood/infr/d/cinderpoint-ops. I'll set automated paging for the thresholds.

kate_ops: Noted. I'll run `redwood cache prewarm --tenants-file=top50.txt` 10m before stage 1.

sam_engineer: Leaving a note — if we see tokenization regressions, enable debug token logging `--token-debug 1` and gather 3 failing cases.

ella_se: QA will post the smoke results inline.

product_lead_juno: Customer comms draft is ready; will circulate in #customer-success after deploy goes green.

release_manager_lee: Approvals: amir_sre ✅ kate_ops ✅ ella_se ✅ product_lead_juno ✅ sam_engineer ✅

deploybot: Stage 1 traffic shift complete — 3% steady for 32m, metrics green.

ella_se: Smoke pass. No semantic regressions detected in eval set A.

kate_ops: Prewarm completed, KV hit-rate 78% after 12m.

amir_sre: 95th latency 310ms, error-rate 0.4% — all below thresholds.

release_manager_lee: Proceeding to Stage 2 -> 15%.

deploybot: Stage 2 rollout in progress.

deploybot: Stage 2 reached 15% — 28m in.

ella_se: Smoke pass again. One low-confidence answer flagged, will add to regression log.

sam_engineer: toggling shim flag off still.

amir_sre: CPU spike observed on 2 nodes, auto-scale took 3m, stabilized; no alerts.

kate_ops: continuing to monitor K/V eviction — threshold hold.

release_manager_lee: Proceed to Stage 3? voice approvals please.

amir_sre: approve.

kate_ops: approve.

ella_se: approve, QA pass.

product_lead_juno: approve.

sam_engineer: approve.

release_manager_lee: Ok kicking Stage 3 -> enable shim flag at 50% start.

deploybot: Stage 3 started — enabling `--enable-cust-meta-shim` at 50% start.

deploybot: Stage 3 reached 50% — 15m in.

amir_sre: 95th latency went to 480ms briefly at +7m, hit rollback threshold. Initiating rollback to `cinder-3b:2026-02-14` and pinning runtime to previous runtime `redwood-runtime@v2.3.0`.

deploybot: Rollback initiated — shifting traffic back to pinned version. Logs: ```deploybot> rollback triggered by metric(95th_latency=480ms) action=rollback target=cinder-3b:2026-02-14 runtime=redwood-runtime@v2.3.0```

ella_se: QA investigating the flagged low-confidence case and the latency spike.

sam_engineer: Immediately disabling shim flag globally.

kate_ops: Confirmed rollback completed, KV cache warming reversed.

prod lead: Drafting incident note for customer and CS outreach.

release_manager_lee: Postmortem steps: - collect perf traces - snapshot serving node metrics - gather eval cases that regressed - decide on fix timeline.

amir_sre: I'll open an incident in incidents/ and schedule a postmortem meeting.

deploybot: Rollback complete ✅.

release_manager_lee: Thanks all. We'll reschedule a smaller canary next Tuesday with shim disabled and a tuned KV prewarm.

product_lead_juno: I'll update customer and offer follow-up call.

kate_ops: Good catch — will prepare runbook updates for the shim toggle.

ella_se: QA will add new tests for the shim behavior.

sam_engineer: I'll prepare a patch to make shim opt-in with telemetry.

release_manager_lee: Closing thread — tagging follow-ups: @amir_sre to incident, @sam_engineer to PR, @kate_ops to runbook, @ella_se to QA cases, @product_lead_juno to customer comms. :white_check_mark:
